name: P3 - Workflow 1 - Customer Profile Lookup (Sanitized - Review Needed)

parameters.command:
=export CUSTOMER_ID="{{ $('When called by Agent').first().json.customer_id || $json.customer_id || $json.query?.customer_id || '' }}"
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import sqlite3, json, os

customer_id = os.environ.get("CUSTOMER_ID", "").strip()

if not customer_id:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "customer_id is required"}))
else:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("REPLACE_WITH_SHARED_DATA_PATH/customers.db")
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute("SELECT * FROM customers WHERE customer_id = ?", (customer_id,))
    row = c.fetchone()
    conn.close()

    if row is None:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "customer not found", "customer_id": customer_id}))
    else:
        print(json.dumps(dict(row)))
PYEOF

assignments.name: profile
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const r = JSON.parse($json.stdout || '{}'); if (String($('When called by Agent').item.json.include_pii) !== 'true') { delete r.name; } return r; })() }}
